title: The truth The Boss hid from Big Boss in Metal Gear
subject: bigboss
description:
Should The Boss have told him the truth? 👇

The Boss's defection was never what it looked like, and Big Boss found out too late. Spoilers for Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Konami. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: The traitor Big Boss killed in 1964 was following orders.
The Boss never defected. Her real mission was to bring home the Philosophers' Legacy, a secret fortune the Soviets had hidden.
Volgin's nuclear strike wrecked that plan. To prove America's innocence and stop a war, Washington needed her dead, by Snake's hand.
She knew it from the start and said nothing to him.
Snake heard the truth from a tape that EVA left behind.
At Arlington, he saluted his mentor's grave. The headstone carried no name.
